ObjectStates.LuaScript:
btColor = {r=1, g=0, b=0}
scriptStr = ''
windowOpened = 0
targetObj = nil
memoryList = {}
objectCount = 0

function onLoad(en_state)
    local state = JSON.decode(en_state)
    if state ~= nil then
        if state.str ~= nil then
            scriptStr = state.str
        end
        if state.ml ~= nil then
            memoryList = state.ml
        end
        if state.oc ~= nil then
            objectCount = state.oc
        end
    end
    makeInitButtons()
    self.UI.setValue('objectNumber', 'Selected Object : '..objectCount..' --- variable name = "obj"')
    local objs = getObjects()
    for i = 1, #objs do
        if objs[i].getName() == 'egr50oi8jh' then
            objs[i].destroyObject()
        end
    end
end

function makeInitButtons()
    self.createButton({position={x=0, y=0.21, z=-0.46}, scale={4, 4, 3.4}, color={1, 0, 0}, 
        click_function='setScript', function_owner=self, tooltip='Set the script'})
    self.createButton({position={x=0, y=0.21, z=0.36}, scale={4, 4, 3.4}, color={0, 0.8, 0}, 
        click_function='runScript', function_owner=self, tooltip='Run the script'})
end

function onEndEdit(player, value, id)
    self.UI.setAttribute('if', 'text', value)
    scriptStr = value
end

function setScript(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    if alt_click == true then return end
    if windowOpened == 0 then
        windowOpened = 1
        self.UI.setAttribute('mainPanel', 'active', 'true')
        self.UI.setAttribute('if', 'text', scriptStr)
    else
        windowOpened = 0
        self.UI.setAttribute('mainPanel', 'active', 'false')
    end
end

runInterval = 0
function runScript(obj, player_color, alt_click)
    if alt_click == true then return end
    local zobj = nil
    if runInterval ~= 0 then
        return
    end
    runInterval = 1
    if targetObj ~= nil then
        targetObj.destroyObject()
    end
    local pos = self.getPosition()
    local spawnParams = {
        type = 'ScriptingTrigger',
        position = {x=0, y=-500, z=0},
        scale = {x=0.01, y=0.01, z=0.01},
    }
    targetObj = spawnObject(spawnParams)
    targetObj.setName('egr50oi8jh')
    local pre_str = [=[function userFunction(guid)
    local obj = nil
    if guid ~= nil then
        obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
    end
]=]
    local post_str = [=[

end]=]
    targetObj.setLuaScript(pre_str .. scriptStr .. post_str)
    if objectCount > 0 then
        Wait.frames(function ()
            for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
                targetObj.call('userFunction', guid)
            end
            runInterval = 0
        end, 20)
    else
        Wait.frames(function ()
            targetObj.call('userFunction', nil)
            runInterval = 0
        end, 20)
    end
end

function onSave()
    local state = {
        str = scriptStr,
        ml = memoryList,
        oc = objectCount
    }
    return JSON.encode(state)
end

--Creates selection buttons on objects
function createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    local howManyButtons = 2
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        if obj ~= self then
            local dummyIndex = howManyButtons
            --On a normal bag, the button positions aren't the same size as the bag.
            local globalScaleFactor = 1.0 * 1 / self.getScale().x
            --Super sweet math to set button positions
            local selfPos = self.getPosition()
            local objPos = obj.getPosition()
            local deltaPos = findOffsetDistance(selfPos, objPos, obj)
            local objPos = rotateLocalCoordinates(deltaPos, self)
            objPos.x = -objPos.x * globalScaleFactor
            objPos.y = objPos.y * globalScaleFactor + 1
            objPos.z = objPos.z * globalScaleFactor
            --Offset rotation of bag
            local rot = self.getRotation()
            rot.y = -rot.y + 180
            --Create function
            local funcName = "selectButton_" .. howManyButtons
            local func = function() buttonClick_selection(dummyIndex, obj) end
            self.setVar(funcName, func)
            self.createButton({
                click_function=funcName, function_owner=self,
                position=objPos, rotation=rot, height=500, width=500,
                color={0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6},
            })
            howManyButtons = howManyButtons + 1
        end
    end
end

--Find delta (difference) between 2 x/y/z coordinates
function findOffsetDistance(p1, p2, obj)
    local deltaPos = {}
    local bounds = obj.getBounds()
    deltaPos.x = (p2.x-p1.x)
    deltaPos.y = (p2.y-p1.y) + (bounds.size.y - bounds.offset.y)
    deltaPos.z = (p2.z-p1.z)
    return deltaPos
end

--Used to rotate a set of coordinates by an angle
function rotateLocalCoordinates(desiredPos, obj)
	local objPos, objRot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
    local angle = math.rad(objRot.y)
	local x = desiredPos.x * math.cos(angle) - desiredPos.z * math.sin(angle)
	local z = desiredPos.x * math.sin(angle) + desiredPos.z * math.cos(angle)
	--return {x=objPos.x+x, y=objPos.y+desiredPos.y, z=objPos.z+z}
    return {x=x, y=desiredPos.y, z=z}
end

--Checks or unchecks buttons
function buttonClick_selection(index, obj)
    local color = {0,1,0,0.6}
    if memoryList[obj.getGUID()] == nil then
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        --Adding pos/rot to memory table
        local pos, rot = obj.getPosition(), obj.getRotation()
        --I need to add it like this or it won't save due to indexing issue
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = {
            pos={x=round(pos.x,4), y=round(pos.y,4), z=round(pos.z,4)},
            rot={x=round(rot.x,4), y=round(rot.y,4), z=round(rot.z,4)},
            lock=obj.getLock()
        }
        obj.highlightOn({0,1,0})
    else
        color = {0.75,0.25,0.25,0.6}
        self.editButton({index=index, color=color})
        memoryList[obj.getGUID()] = nil
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

function onObjectSelect(player, value, id)
    if self.UI.getAttribute('objectSelectBt', 'text') == 'Select Object' then
        memoryList = {}
        self.UI.setAttribute('objectSelectBt', 'text', 'Summit Selection')
        createButtonsOnAllObjects()
    else
        self.UI.setAttribute('objectSelectBt', 'text', 'Select Object')
        self.clearButtons()
        objectListSubmit()
        makeInitButtons()
    end
end

function objectListSubmit()
    objectCount = 0
    for guid in pairs(memoryList) do
        objectCount = objectCount + 1
        local obj = getObjectFromGUID(guid)
        if obj ~= nil then obj.highlightOff() end
    end
    broadcastToAll(objectCount.." Objects Listed", {1,1,1})
    self.UI.setValue('objectNumber', 'Selected Object : '..objectCount..' --- variable name = "obj"')
    onSave()
end

--Moves scripted highlight from all objects
function removeAllHighlights()
    for _, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
        obj.highlightOff()
    end
end

--Round number (num) to the Nth decimal (dec)
function round(num, dec)
  local mult = 10^(dec or 0)
  return math.floor(num * mult + 0.5) / mult
end
